counterexample: Broken-world challenge: an image that merely ships a package.json but omits better-sqlite3 or NODE_PATH could look valid in a source inventory and make an otherwise conforming database app fail with MODULE_NOT_FOUND; a stale COPY could silently feed it the wrong seed. The network-none native SQL probe plus exact file hashes refute these counterexamples for this image. A static-shell app can still run in this correctly provisioned image; row 15 is an environment check and does not establish application correctness. Conforming alternative: a differently organized CommonJS app using Express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins, copying the supplied assets into /app and launching server.js without npm install, has its declared dependencies available independent of the reference schema/UI. No image-specific false failure for that alternative was found.
